en: Whew! I'm glad I at least got one.
Well, folks. Haruka-chan worked hard and managed to get a prize, which we will now be giving away to one lucky viewer. Now's your chance!
Oh, too bad! You didn't get a single prize!
I'm so sorry, everyone who's watching!
Hey, but you know what, folks? Now you get the chance to win a signed, personal article from our guest instead!
Have you thought about what you'll be giving away to our viewers today, Haruka-chan?
I have! I'm going to give away an autographed T-shirt, one that I wore during one of my lessons.
An autographed T-shirt, folks! That's something any fan would love!
(Did I get any gifts from fans?)
You got <Color:8>Tauriner<Color:Default>.
(Oh! What a nice gift! I'm so happy!)
You got <Color:8>Fan Letter<Color:Default>.
(Oh, wow! A fan letter!)
(I never thought I'd see the day when I'd actually be getting fan mail!)
(I wonder what everyone back at Morning Glory would say?)
You got a <Color:8>Toughness Z<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Gold Ring<Color:Default>.
(I can't believe it! A ring!? I don't know if I should accept something this valuable... But it would be rude to send it back.)
(I'll just think of it as a heartfelt expression of a fan's devotion.)
(But what a huge surprise! I'll cherish this ring forever.)
You got <Color:8>Handmade Bracelet<Color:Default>.
(What's this? A handmade bracelet? What beautiful craftsmanship!)
(This person used their own precious time to make this, just for me. How sweet!)
You got <Color:8>Messages from Fans<Color:Default>.
(Wow! Look at this! Messages from my fans!)
(Oh! This person always comes to cheer me on. How nice!)
(Thank you, everyone. Your kind words help me work all the harder!)
(I guess there aren't any right now.)
Ah, I lost! Haruka, I think you've gotten even better than before!
You think so? Thanks!
Yep! I'd better start working harder if I want to catch up to you!
Well, I'll see you around! Let's do this again, okay?
Okay. See you, Akari!
Received a <Color:8>8,000 yen<Color:Default> tip from the audience.
Hey, that was a pretty great battle! Now I need my fee. It's 500 yen.
You paid <Color:8>500 yen<Color:Default>.
Whenever you want to feel the thrill of another exciting dance battle, just come see me!
Hey, aren't you paying attention in those lessons of yours? You aren't dancing as well as you usually do.
Trust me. I can tell. I mean, we're friends, right? You definitely gotta put some more oomph into it.
Yeah, I'll try to do that next time.
Well, I'll be seeing you! Let's do this again, okay?
I lost again!? Ugh, I can't believe it!
Geez, how'd you get so good in such a short time, anyway? You're positively frightening, you know.
Anyways. I hope you ask me again sometime. You gotta give me a chance to get revenge!
Hehe. Okay, I definitely will!
Heheh. See what I did there? If I give it my all, the odds'll always be in my favor.
*pant* *pant* You did great, Maki-san.
Yep. If you're ever looking to get revenge, I'll be more than happy to come back.
I'll do that. Thank you.
*pant* *pant* You did it, Sawamura-san. It looks like I still can't beat you, even when I try my best.
Aww, don't say that. Your performance was great!
You don't have to try and make me feel better. I'm glad, actually. Now I have something to work toward.
Well, I'll see you later, Sawamura-san. You'll invite me back, right?
Of course! I'll be seeing you!
What happened, Sawamura-san? Is that really the best you can do?
You were much better the last time we battled.
I... I was?
Hmph. I just think you're not showing me everything you've got. I hope we can do this again, because I want to see how much you've really learned!
Yes, we'll definitely do this again.
Heh, you're pretty good.
*pant* *pant* Thank you!
Invite me back sometime, okay? But I'm warning you. Next time I won't lose!
Hehe, you can count on it!
What's the matter, Haruka Sawamura? Not feeling your best?
Hm. I guess things can't always go in your favor.
I hope you'll let me try again sometime.
Thank you, Judy-san!
Wait a minute! Did I really just lose!?
*pant* I did it!
Well, well, well. You really did it, Haruka-san. I guess I need to start working harder! Heheh.
I'm looking forward to our next battle!
Yes, I did it! I won!
Haruka-san! What are you doing, losing to a guy like me?
Momiyama-san, please let me try again! Next time I won't lose!
Heheh. Sure! I'll be waiting for your invite.
Great! Thank you!
No, I lost!
Thank you very much for the battle, Ririka-san. It's been a valuable experience.
You really think so? Then I'm glad.
I had a lot of fun. Make sure you invite me back again, okay?
I definitely will!
Looks like I won this time!
Wow, Haruka-chan! You've really got some skills. You're miles above me!
Oh, Ema-chan, that's not true. I learned so much watching you dance!
Really? Hehe. Thanks!
...Damn it.
Gah, I won't let you beat me next time! You better invite me here again!
Okay, I will! See you later, Ema-chan!
Ah! I did it! I won!
Wow, you're great, Ema-chan! I learned so much from watching you dance!
...As if you could beat me anyways.
I'm gonna win the next time, too! Hehe. So invite me back, okay?
Not... Not bad.
You really think so? Hehe. Thank you.
If you ever want to have another dance battle, just let me know, all right?
And it's not like I'm doing this for you, okay!
Oh, I know. Well, see you!
Hmph. It looks like you still aren't ready to beat me.
Yeah. I need to work harder in my lessons!
Well, if you ever want a revenge match, just let me know, all right?
Huh? Did I lose?
Yes. It looks like I won, Seira-san.
I guess you're right. But, whatever. I don't mind!
The important thing was that we had fun. Let's do it again sometime!
It was fun! Yes, we'll do it again.
Yes! I won!
Your dancing was really great, Seira-san.
You think so? Thanks! But, whatever.
I swore I'd never let you beat me again. I've been training so hard, but you still won!
*pant* *pant* I could really tell how hard you've been working, Amon-san.
Gah! Just you wait, Haruka Sawamura. I'll bring you down yet!
Hehe. I'll look forward to it.
Received a <Color:8>10,000 yen<Color:Default> tip from the audience.
Hehe. I win.
*pant* You're very good!
Come back and see me when you can provide a real challenge. I'll be waiting.
Yes, let's try this again soon.
*pant* *pant* You're very good!
Unbelievable! This is what can pass for a pop idol these days? Hmph!
You're nothing like Kazuma Kiryu! Beating someone as weak as you is hardly something I can be proud of.
Come back and see me when you can provide a real challenge. I'll be right here. Waiting.
*pant* *pant* I won! Whew, that was not easy.
Well done, Haruka Sawamura. I guess I shouldn't have expected anything less from the girl raised by Kazuma Kiryu himself.
Anyways, this has been an interesting fact-finding mission. Just so you know, I won't hold back in our next battle.
Our next battle?
That's right. We still need to settle things between us in one of your little concert battles.
When you're ready, come to Soten TV. I'll construct the perfect place for you to meet your doom.
(Gosh, I wonder what she has planned...)
(Soten TV, huh? I'll have to take a taxi.)
(Let's see. I'm pretty sure the letter said she'd be waiting somewhere around here.)
Oh, are you Noa Amon? The one who wrote the letter?
That's right. I am the eldest daughter of the Amon Clan.
I'm surprised you decided to show up. Pretty brave. I'll give you that much, Haruka Sawamura.
Um, do we know each other?
Hey, don't play dumb with me! You know perfectly well that I called you here to settle things between us, once and for all.
Now, let's do this!
(What do I do? I think there's something off about this person. It'd be better to not get involved.)
I'm sorry, I actually have something urgent to do. Maybe we can do this another time? Now, if you'll excuse me⑬
Hm!? How do you know that name?
The Amon Clan and Kiryu are archrivals. You were raised by him. You're practically his daughter. That means you and I, we are rivals too.
Wait a minute. What do you mean, archrivals? And who exactly is the Amon Clan anyways?
The Amon Clan is a legendary assassin group. Once targeted by the Amon, nobody escapes alive.
That is, until he showed up.
You mean Uncle Kaz?
That's right. Kazuma Kiryu. When he appeared, the Amon's reputation started to waver. Since then, our clan has sworn to bring him down.
I'd love to be able to take Kazuma Kiryu out myself, but the Amon Clan has an ironclad rule against women and men engaging in battle.
And I had the misfortune of being born a woman. But then, just when I felt I had to take my frustration out on someone, you came along.
That's right. You, Kazuma Kiryu's loved one. And not only that. A new pop idol with amazing performance skills, too.
If I defeated you, I could finally hold my head high as a member of the Amon Clan. Even if I can't fight Kazuma Kiryu myself.
I... I'm not sure what to say.
Then don't say anything! Ugh, you aren't anything like Kazuma Kiryu, are you? Just shut up and let your abilities do the talking!
We're going to do this, right now!
Unbelievable! I barely even tried. Come on!
Defeating someone as weak as you is hardly something I can be proud of.
Ahh! Why!?
Why can't I beat you!?
The Amon Clan has passed our knowledge down through the generations, all with the aim of being the best!
If I lose to someone like you, what does that make me!?
Do you know what I think? I think that if your whole purpose in doing something is to be the best, you'll never be able to do so.
I just mean, that if a person is truly good at what they do, they strive not to be the best, but rather toward a specific dream or conviction.
A person needs to be motivated by something positive, not something like pride or revenge. If she wants to be truly great, there's no other way.
I really believe that.
...Heh.
So not only do I lose, but I have to get a lecture, too? Looks like I'm still the disgrace of the Amon Clan.
I didn't mean for it to be a lecture. I'm sorry.
You have nothing to apologize for. That belief of yours got you this far. I mean, you won, didn't you? You're probably right.
All my life, I've had a chip on my shoulder about being born a woman. I was always worried about bringing shame upon the Amon name.
With that kind of negative thinking, I guess I was setting myself up to fail from the start.
Amon-san...
Well, you beat me this time. I must rethink what it means to be truly great.
Haruka Sawamura. Thank you.
I'm glad I got a chance to go up against you. But I'm warning you⑬next time I will not lose!
(Amon-san, you're stronger than you think.)
(But gosh. Uncle Kaz sure has a lot of enemies.)
You got 50,000 experience points.
(I came to Soten TV, like Amon-san said. But where is she?)
I've been waiting for you, Haruka Sawamura.
Oh. So, why Soten TV? Is there something you have in mind?
Hmph. What else? That, of course!
Obviously! What better place to defeat you than on your precious Princess League stage?
Are you serious? How were you even able to arrange this?
I told you. The Amon Clan is an assassin group. As such, we have done work for all kinds of very important people. From those in political circles, to those in the mafia.
There isn't an industry here that the Amon Clan can't reach. Getting a stage set up identical to the Princess League was simple.
Wow. I can't believe this.
Oh, come on, let's get on with it! If you're supposed to be the best and I beat you, then that means I'm the best. Hehe. You'll make a fine stepping stone, Haruka Sawamura!
(Should I change my outfit up a little?)
(Oh! I'll wear this to my next job!)
(All right. Back to the village.)
(I'll stay a bit longer.)
(Still gotta tag Yama-oroshi with a transmitter shot. Should I go back down first?)
What, you're going back down?
Yeah. We'll go back for now.
No. We'll keep goin'.
There they are.
Crouch down and sneak closer. Shoot when you're close enough.
Experienced hunters aim for the heart, but that's a difficult thing for beginners. For you, it'll be easier to aim for the head.
Target the one that presents you with the best shot.
You can fell game with just one bullet if you hit its head. Try sneaking up to your target quietly and dropping it with one head shot.
